symptom: `move java action A.X to B` (and `move javascript action`) reparented the document and left javasource/a/actions/X.java (javascriptsource/a/actions/X.js) behind. DESCRIBE then printed the 'Java source not available' placeholder, so re-executing its output replaced the code. Measured on 11.13.0: mx check passed and `docker build` succeeded, but the class the app calls, jamb/actions/JA_Hello, was mxbuild's generated stub throwing 'Java action was not implemented', and the author's code compiled only as an orphaned jama.actions class; the page bundle for a JS action carried 'JavaScript action was not implemented'
cause: execMove's movers change containment only; RenameJavaSourceFile existed for a rename within the module, but nothing moved the source between module directories
file: `mdl/executor/cmd_move.go` (`moveActionSource`, run before the document moves, undone by a deferred move back if the statement fails), `mdl/backend/modelsdk/java_write.go` (`MoveJavaSourceFile`, `moveSourceFile`), `javascript_write.go` (`MoveJavaScriptSourceFile`), `sdk/javaactions/rename.go` (`MoveSource`, `rewriteGenerated`)
insight: A green build is not evidence here: mxbuild regenerates every action stub where the model puts it and compiles the old file too, so the move only shows as a runtime throw - read the compiled class out of project.jar (`strings jamb/actions/JA_Hello.class`) or grep the page bundle, and a JS action is only bundled when a nanoflow on a page calls it. The oracle for the source rewrite is mxbuild run IN PLACE on a source moved with nothing else changed: it rewrote exactly one line, `package jama.actions;` -> `package jamb.actions;`, and kept user code that mentions the old package (testdata/mxbuild/JA_Moved*). Move the source before the document so an occupied destination refuses the statement with the model unchanged
